rendered_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one square opaque dialogue portrait for a Chinese wuxia RPG, shoulder-and-upper-chest framing.
Primary request: Create a NEW portrait of an ordinary mature Chinese innkeeper, about forty years old. This is a new illustration, not an edit of any existing image.
Subject: One man with a mature natural face, dark eyebrows, black hair tied in a small practical topknot, a restrained short moustache and short chin beard. Calm, honest, welcoming expression; a working proprietor, not a roaming merchant or martial hero. Plain deep navy-blue cross-collar cloth clothes, muted brown inner layer, and a beige coarse-linen work apron with its upper bib/straps visible across the upper chest.
Scene/backdrop: A softly defocused warm wooden inn interior. Quiet timber surfaces and gentle ambient warmth; no additional people, no legible signs.
Style/medium: Semi-realistic hand-painted wuxia game portrait: natural mature anatomy, solid sculpted facial planes, subtle visible painterly texture, believable coarse cloth, restrained outlines and warm/cool depth. Not a photograph, not flat anime, not glossy 3D CG.
Composition/framing: A single centered head-and-shoulders / upper-chest portrait, close to eye level, facing the viewer with a very slight three-quarter turn. Full small topknot and both shoulders fit comfortably inside the square; the face remains clearly readable when displayed small in a dialogue portrait frame. Do not show the full body, a sprite strip, multiple copies or a circular frame.
Lighting/mood: Soft warm inn light with clear face modeling and a friendly, down-to-earth atmosphere; no dramatic combat lighting.
Constraints: Opaque square artwork with the inn background filling the entire canvas. Exactly one person. Keep the black small topknot, short facial hair, navy clothing and beige apron consistent throughout. No straw hat, no hood, no travel cloak, no pack or shoulder satchel, no weapon, no armor, no jewelry, no exaggerated heroic physique. Do not dress him in a brown traveling outer robe.
Text: None. No lettering, captions, UI, border, watermark or signature. No transparent background or cutout requirement.
